purpose: Identify an action as currently in progress.
keywords: I am in the middle of making lunch.
I am currently checking the documents.
I was just getting ready to go home.
restrictions: Focuses on the stage of the action at the reference time.
mistake: ところ here is not a physical place.

segments.role: Identify an action as currently in progress. て-form + いるところ.
